name: Cycle Thread
description: Run a thread of cycling qi round a foe's arm so it winds back to the same spot.

name: Coil Lash
description: Lash a ring of qi out and snap it back across the foe's guard in a second cut.

name: Turning Ward
description: Turn the forearm in a quick circle and wheel a blow aside along the arc.

name: Revolve Step
description: Revolve round the foe's guard on small steps and end facing the open side.

name: Turning Reading
description: Feel the rise and fall of the foe's breath and name the moment it turns.

name: Ring Return
description: Hurl a spinning ring of qi that strikes the foe and comes back to the hand with a second cut.

name: Wheel Bind
description: Spin a wheel of qi round the foe's torso so each struggle turns the wheel and tightens it.

name: Rising Breath
description: Lift an ally from a fall with a breath that clears the dizziness and braces the knees.

name: Steady Pulse
description: Steady the beat of an ally's heart to bring back focus after a shock.

name: Recover Guard
description: Rebuild a guard of qi after it breaks, closing the gap in a single breath.

name: Reclaim Strike
description: Strike back the instant a blow lands and take some of its strength as renewed qi.

name: Mending Cycle
description: Turn a ring of mending qi through an ally's wounds so torn flesh draws together turn by turn.

name: Cleansing Turn
description: Run an ally's blood through a slow ring of qi that sheds taint and poison at each turn.

name: Husk Shell
description: Grow a husk of dried qi round the body that takes a blow and then falls away.

name: Husk Dart
description: Throw a splinter of husk that bursts into a spray of dry qi at the target.

name: Empty Double
description: Leave a hollow double of the self standing and step out of its place.

name: Husk Sense
description: Sense the husks of old qi left behind by anyone who passed close by.

name: Dry Bind
description: Throw a net of husk threads over a foe's hands that stiffens and clamps.

name: Fallen Skin
description: Let the outer layer of qi fall away as a blow lands, so the strike loses its bite.

name: Husk Burst
description: Burst a husk of stored qi outward in a ring that rattles everyone close to the user.

name: Fresh Layer
description: Lay a fresh layer of qi skin under an ally's husk and heal the scrapes below.

name: Old Knowing
description: Draw on the faint memory of other lives to guess a stranger's trade from the hands.

name: Familiar Step
description: Move through a fight as if every turn were known and set the foot before the foe moves.

name: Recall Guard
description: Block a strike by recalling how it was blocked before and moving the arm the same way.

name: Past Edge
description: Thrust with an edge sharpened by long practice across lives before this one.

name: Knowing Eye
description: Read the foe's whole fighting style from a few passes, as if met before.

name: Prior Blow
description: Strike the spot the foe is about to move, breaking the step before it starts.
